/input/grab: Grab (tap: holds until the next press)
/input/a_hold: A held (black wrist button, long press: FluxAction1 left / FluxAction2 right in Resonite)
/input/system: System (the glove button set in the driver's settings)
/input/pink: Pink wrist button (left: the SteamVR dashboard; right: mute, with the bridge's right pink set to SteamVR)
/input/two_finger_point: Two-finger point (hand tracking: index and middle out, the thumb over the others)
Setting_OpticalTapHook: Use headset hand tracking for fingers (Steam Link)
Setting_ForwardTapSystem: Quest left palm pinch also opens the dashboard (the left pink button always does)
Setting_BlackHold: Black button long press after this many ms: the A held input (Resonite: FluxAction1/2 with the MoreFluxActions mod). 0 = no long press
Setting_PoseFilter: Filter Steam Link's hand pose (off: pass it through as streamed; Virtual Desktop's is never filtered)
Setting_ImuFusion: Hand orientation from the glove's IMU (the headset keeps it aligned; also through occlusions)
Setting_YieldToControllers: Hand over to the Touch controllers when you pick them up, and take the hands back when hand tracking returns
Setting_HideOtherHandControllers: Hide the streamer's hand tracking and other hand controllers from apps while CyberFinger holds the hands
Setting_DebugCaptures: Debug captures: record hand data on request (tools/analyze_tap_capture.py)
Setting_PoseFilterMinCutoff: Pose filter: smoothing when still (Hz, lower = smoother)
Setting_PoseFilterBeta: Pose filter: responsiveness when moving (higher = less lag)
Setting_PoseRotationPrediction: Rotation prediction (0 = none, 1 = full; above 0 the laser jitters)
Setting_GrabTapToHold: Grab: tap to hold (a quick tap of the grip holds until the next press; off: the grab follows the grip)
Setting_GrabTapMs: Grab: with tap to hold, a tap shorter than this (ms) holds
Setting_TrackingLevel_Partial: Partial (VRChat: keeps its hand-gesture controls off)
Setting_SystemButton: Glove button for the SteamVR dashboard
Setting_GripAngleX: Fallback pose rotation X (no headset skeleton)
Setting_GripAngleY: Fallback pose rotation Y (no headset skeleton)
Setting_GripAngleZ: Fallback pose rotation Z (no headset skeleton)
Setting_Active: CyberFinger controllers active (off: the headset's own hand tracking takes the hands)
